Our other unit in Shocker Cube found a mystery key but lost it in a fierce battle. Investigate the site.
We've been waiting for you. Let's get right to our request.
We of the Maganac Corps have been carrying out an investigation here, inside Shocker Cube.
And in the course of that investigation, we found a mysterious key.
A key? A key to what?
Yes. Our investigation revealed that it's the key to one of the exhibit rooms here in Shocker Cube.
We're told an old sword is on display inside.
A sword!? Don't tell me that sword is on display here!?
Hey, when you go to that room, you're taking me with you.
Is something on your mind?
If I use that sword, I might be able to get my lost power back.
I'm counting on you.
Can't be helped. But first we've gotta find the key.
Do you have any idea where you dropped the key?
Yes. We were fighting in an open area at the bottom of a pitfall.
I remember light leaking through the cracks in a nearby wall.
I see. With that much to go on, we should be able to manage.
Sorry for the trouble. We're counting on you.
A sword? Couldn't God Gundam use it?

notes.note: Quest018.bla plays row TextIdOffset+N+1. Leader block 112-126 (+111+k) in Pt_Chara_Check order (k from the LOADK pairs in the chain): Shotaro, OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, God, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero; so 124 Nu, 125 00, 126 Wing Zero. Same English as quest_019's 115-123.
127-128 Money Dopant (CHARA_NAME 272, +126/+127) on the win route: he denies his 'Tch!' and pays out.
130/133 and 160 are not referenced by the script (it shows OkWin +161/+162 = rows 162/163 on both routes). Item name 'Gold Nugget' per ItemNameFormal 3.94.

Lose route: script plays only +136/+137 (rows 137-138) then the battle, then +156 (row 157). Rows 139-155 are unused: 139-153 a 15-row leader block (identical Japanese, identical English), 154 Money Dopant.

Rows 166-286 are a second quest (the Shocker Cube exhibit-room key / rusty sword) that no script references and that has no QuestMess title; all speakers inferred from wording. 166 is a quest-board description (three-line source box), compressed to the 2-line limit like earlier quest descriptions; 'betsudoutai' rendered 'our other unit'.

168-170, 172-173, 183-184, 186, 206-207, 209: Maganac (Corps spokesman, polite 'we'). 171/178/181/182/185 the party leader (rough 'shikata nee'; leader identity not fixed by any script). 176/177/179/180 God Gundam (Domon voice): 189 confirms the alternate branch is for when God Gundam is absent.
Source 'hirogeta basho' read as 'hiraketa' (open area); 207 has the typo 'hibi' (days) for 'hibi' (cracks), translated as cracks like 184.

Speaker of 189 and 204 unknown (a party member who suggests God Gundam); voiced neutral. 190-203 is a 14-row leader block (the 15 leaders minus God Gundam); order unknown, voiced from wording: 194 rough 'yarou ze', 197 polite 'agemashou', the rest 'yaru ka'.

212 speaker unknown (leader); 213 written to work as either narration or the same speaker. 215 'Exhibit Room Key' is not in the item tables (cut item); named after the 'Exhibit Room' rendering used elsewhere.
217-231 is a 15-row leader block (continues in quest_021); 222 rough ('chigai nee na'), 225 polite ('desu ne'); identical Japanese kept identical.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest018.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N+1) for 124-163; rows 166-225 belong to an unreferenced second quest, speakers inferred from wording. New item name 'Exhibit Room Key' (not in item tables).
